01 — THE RESIDENCESLOT 82588 · JALAN SEGAMBUT

Room for every
kind of together.

Planned across 4.74 acres beside Dutamas, Ophira comprises two residential towers with 1,546 homes: 914 in Tower A and 632 in Tower B.

Choose from 12 named layouts spanning 1+1 to four bedrooms. Selected plans add dual-key configurations, balconies or designated flexible walls.

The current target completion is Q4 2031. Project details and timelines may change; confirm the latest information before making a decision.

03 — DETAILS THAT WORK FOR YOUHOME FEATURES

Considered details.
Everyday ease.

Features in the sales kit focus on useful flexibility, connected home controls and practical fittings.

01

A kitchen ready to use

Kitchen fitted by SIGNATURE, with electric hob and self-circulating hood. Hob configuration varies by layout.

02

Smart-home essentials

Published system features include a smart hub, switches, window/door sensors, motion sensor, smart clicker, CCTV and digital lockset.

03

Comfort from day one

Two inverter air-conditioners are listed for each home: one in a bedroom and one in the living room. Instant water heater is also provided.

04

More adaptable space

Selected plans are dual-key enabled. Designated internal walls are described as hackable, subject to approved details and restrictions.

05

GreenRE certified

The residence is listed as GreenRE certified in the project materials.

06

Space for natural light

Published layouts highlight ventilation and natural lighting, with approximate 2.8 m clear ceiling height.

Specifications vary between unit types. Refer to the latest product information and sale documents for the exact inclusions.

04 — A DAY WELL SPENT

Thirty-nine places
to move, rest and meet.

Podium facilities on Level 10 bring water, wellness, play and social spaces together. Sky gardens are planned for Tower A Level 53A and Tower B Level 51.

WATER

Lap pool · wet deck · family pool · kids’ splash zone · aqua gym · jacuzzi

WELLNESS

Gymnasium · yoga deck · exercise stations · wellness garden · green stairway

PLAY

Adventure and canopy playgrounds · kids’ discovery room · family games room · music room

GATHER

Social lounge · amphitheatre terrace · sky view plaza · function hall · co-working space
